values.note: FS: 'Maximum RV length is 45 feet'; three loops including an overflow loop (sites 31-38, no picnic tables). The FS text says 31 campsites, 6 pull-through; recreation.gov's catalog lists 37 public sites (01-38 less host site 25; site 20 a double), 16 pull-through, lengths 30-60 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/elk-creek-campground ('Maximum RV length is 45 feet'; 'The campground has 31 campsites (6 are pull-through)'; 'Camping sites 31 through 38 are located in the overflow loop') + recreation.gov catalog for 273348 (38 sites, 25 HOST; Max Vehicle Length 30-60; 16 Pull-Through), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog for 273348 (site 10 STANDARD ELECTRIC, Electricity Hookup 30, reservable; the host is site 25, non-electric; all others STANDARD NONELECTRIC) + /rates (a third site rate of $34 beside $29 single / $58 double), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Three hand pumps for drinking water; trailers may not fill at the hydrants (fill before arriving). Trash receptacles.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/elk-creek-campground ('3 vault type toilets, drinking water (3 hand pumps) and refuse receptacles') + recreation.gov 273348 notice ('Trailers are not allowed to fill at any hydrants'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Memorial Day to Labor Day weekends (FS). Closed for the 2026 season; reopens Memorial Day weekend 2027.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/elk-creek-campground ('Seasons of Use: Memorial Day to Labor Day weekends'; 'Closed for the season- Will resume Memorial Day weekend 2027'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov or 1-877-444-6777; 2026 reservations ran May 22 - Sept 7 (2027: May 28 - Sept 6). 15 catalog sites are first-come, including the overflow loop; 'First-come, first-served campsites may be available but not guaranteed.' A reserved site is held until check-out time the day after arrival. 14 days in any 30. Single sites include 6 people and 1 vehicle ($10/night per extra person or second vehicle, up to 8 people and 2 vehicles).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/elk-creek-campground ('Reservations can be made through Recreation.gov or by calling 1-877-444-6777') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273348 (maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days'; notices quoted) + /rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-07, 2027-05-28 to 2027-09-06) + catalog (15 sites not reservable), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $29 a single site, $34 the electric site (10), $58 a double (2026 and 2027). The FS also lists $10 a night for a single site in the shoulder season, without dates. Extra person or second vehicle $10/night.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/273348/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season STANDARD NONELECTRIC 29, double 58, third rate 34) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/elk-creek-campground ('Single Site: $29 per night'; 'Double Site: $58 per night'; 'Single Site: $10 per night (during shoulder season)'), read 2026-10-28

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/elk-creek-campground ('Interagency Senior/Access Recreation Passes provide a 50% discount to single campsites ONLY'), read 2026-10-28

note: Lower Conejos Canyon near Horca, just off Hwy 17 (~23 mi west of Antonito), ~8,500 ft. Lightly wooded with spruce and some ponderosa over grass; a few sites sit next to Elk Creek, with public access to the creek and the Conejos River. Convenient to the South San Juan Wilderness (Elk Creek and Duck Lake trailheads). --Claude
